items.longBusinessSummary: Reddit, Inc. operates a digital community in the United States and internationally. The company's platform enables user to engage in conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share laughs, and find belonging. It also organizes communities based on specific interests that enable users to engage in conversations by sharing experiences, submitting links, uploading images and videos, and replying to one another. Reddit, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Title: Man, 33, Was Saving 70% of His Pay — Then His Dad Became Bedridden: ‘There Can Be Roadblocks You Did Not Expect’
Author: Casey B. Renner   Sun, September 27, 2026 at 1:00 AM GMT+2 7 min read
Published: 2026-09-26T23:00:06+00:00
=== BODY ===
Benzinga and Yahoo Finance LLC may earn commission or revenue on some items through the links below.
A 33-year-old had been saving more than 70% of his take-home pay and making steady progress toward financial independence. Then his family's needs began taking far more of his income than he ever expected.
"So you can plan everything out but still there can be roadblocks that you did not expect," he shared on Reddit.
The poster discovered financial independence, retire early at 26 and wanted to eventually leave the "rat race" and live on his own terms. His salary increased fivefold after he switched jobs between 2021 and 2025, giving him much more room to work toward that goal.
He thought real estate was out of reach on a $60K salary — then he discovered Arrived lets eligible investors start with as little as $100.
You Know The Walking Dead. But Did You Know You Can Invest In The Company Behind It? Shares Start At $12.50.
Part of his income was already going toward his parents, who had no savings and depended entirely on him financially. He covered their expenses and made sure they had adequate health insurance.
His 75-year-old father had been dealing with health problems on and off for eight years, but his condition worsened over three months until he became bedridden. His 66-year-old mother was also dealing with health problems, leaving him with growing expenses for both parents.
His father now needed a full-time physiotherapist and round-the-clock care, along with monthly medications at home that weren't covered by insurance. The added costs brought his savings rate down from more than 70% to just above 10%.
"I planned for everything in terms health insurance, term insurance, emergency fund and whatnot, but things came completely out of nowhere, and are having serious impact on my planning," the poster said.
Trending: Americans Are Drinking More Colombian Coffee. Now Juan Valdez Is Expanding Its U.S. Footprint. The Company Behind The Push Is Already In 3,000+ Stores.
Medical costs outside hospitalization were already a concern for some commenters. One person said medication and outpatient diagnostic tests accounted for most of their spending, while health insurance covered little of it.
"And I am just 26!" they said. "So the costs will compound for the next how many ever years I'll live."
Others were considering how those expenses could affect their longer-term plans. "A medical (contingency) fund apart from regular health/term insurance & the regular FIRE goal corpus is required," another commenter said.
Medical costs can be only one part of a family's financial planning. PCM Encore offers households with at least $1 million in investable assets access to financial planning, investment management, tax and estate services in one place.
See Also: AI Doesn't Run On Chips Alone. This Startup Is Building The Energy Storage Technology Behind The Power Demand.
Others focused less on what the additional expenses meant for the original poster's FIRE timeline. "You saved 70% at one time. That is why you have sufficient (by God grace) to get such superior care for both your parents," a person said.
Someone else who had faced a similar situation with their mother had spent money making some of her final days more comfortable. They said they were satisfied that they had been able to do it and wouldn't trade those memories for anything.
"There is more to life than chasing numbers and attaining [financial independence]," the commenter said.

By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry.
Backed by Jeff Bezos, Arrived Homes makes real estate investing accessible with a low barrier to entry. Investors can buy fractional shares of single-family rentals and vacation homes starting with as little as $100. This allows everyday investors to diversify into real estate, collect rental income, and build long-term wealth without needing to manage properties directly.
For accredited investors looking beyond traditional stocks and bonds, Realberry provides access to institutional-quality real estate investments, including a preferred equity opportunity in the 297-room Hyatt Place Boston Seaport. The firm has invested across multiple property types and markets, with 13 million square feet of real estate across seven U.S. states and $481 million in cumulative distributions paid to investors as of Q4 2025.
Entertainment franchises can become valuable long-term assets when they successfully expand across multiple platforms. Skybound Entertainment, the company behind The Walking Dead and Invincible, develops original intellectual property that spans comics, television, film, video games, merchandise, and licensing. With more than 250 IPs in its portfolio and a strategy focused on retaining franchise rights while scaling successful stories across media, Skybound offers investors exposure to the growing entertainment and creator economy through a private company rather than traditional public market investments.
Coffee is a daily staple for millions of consumers, but investors rarely get direct exposure to the brands and supply chains behind it. Green Coffee Company offers a way to participate in the growth of the coffee market through its exclusive U.S. and Canadian distribution rights for Colombian brand Juan Valdez. With the brand expanding across major retailers including Target, Walgreens and Kroger, and GCC reporting 26X revenue growth over four years, the company is positioning itself to bring a well-known Colombian coffee brand to more consumers across North America.
As artificial intelligence drives a surge in electricity demand, reliable power generation is becoming a critical part of the technology ecosystem. American PowerGen is developing natural gas-fired power plants in Texas, a fast-growing market fueled by AI data centers, manufacturing expansion, and population growth. By advancing projects through permitting, fuel supply, and grid interconnection, the company is positioning itself to help meet rising energy needs while offering investors exposure to the infrastructure supporting the next wave of AI and industrial growth.
As electricity demand rises alongside AI, data centers, and renewable energy, long-duration energy storage is becoming increasingly important. Qnetic is developing a kinetic energy storage system designed to provide long-lasting, chemical-free electricity storage, offering investors exposure to the infrastructure supporting a more resilient and reliable power grid.

A 40-year-old father of two thought he still had more time before deciding whether to walk away from his career. Then he found out his employer was letting him go.
But with $3 million invested and his wife planning to keep working, he isn't looking for another job.
Warren Buffett once said, "If you don't find a way to make money while you sleep, you will work until you die." Here's how you can earn passive income with just $100.
Forget The Rental Property. Some Investors Are Using Real Estate Notes Instead.
The poster had considered quitting eight months earlier but decided to work for at least another 18 months. At the time, they thought another three years on the job could put them in an even stronger position.
The poster's wife already had about $3 million invested in diversified stock exchange-traded funds, including roughly $700,000 in their 401(k)s. They had built most of their wealth through careers in law and tax advisory.
With the poster's wife planning to work for at least another three years, they don't need to start living off that money yet because her income covers their expenses.
"So basically I'm coast [financial independence, retire early]/ stay at home dad for now," they wrote.
The poster wants more time with their kids while they're young and more freedom to ski, mountain bike and occasionally take a midweek trip.
Trending: AI Needs More Power Than The Grid Can Easily Provide. This Startup Is Taking A Different Approach To Energy Storage.
Someone who had been in a similar position suggested making home responsibilities part of their new routine. "Treat home stuff like a job," the person wrote, adding that they should "make sure she still gets time for her own activities."
There was also the day-to-day work of having two young children at home. "Might I suggest taking on the vast majority of household tasks like cooking, cleaning, groceries," one person wrote. "I have two kids under 4 years old and taking care of them is a full time job in itself…"
Once they're both retired, the couple expects to spend about $160,000 a year, including taxes and health care. The original poster hopes their investments will be closer to $4 million by then and is comfortable starting with a withdrawal rate of about 5%.
"Make sure you're prepared for future kid expenses," a commenter wrote. "At your potentially higher withdrawal rate, I would consider doing a little bit of consulting every year to stay in the game, just in case."
See Also: Marvel. Star Wars. Pokémon. See Why Investors Are Paying Attention To The Next Big IP Company.
The OP said consulting could be a good idea, although they aren't planning on it yet. As they get closer to retirement, PCM Encore could also help the couple look at their investment, tax and estate planning together.
The OP believes they could both retire now if they were willing to spend less, but their wife started her career later and is still advancing. She has been supportive of the OP's decision to stop working and is comfortable with them no longer earning an income.
The OP is just as comfortable with her continuing her career. "I'm telling her she can quit when she wants," they wrote. "But she's not ready."

Title: Has Reddit (RDDT) Fallen Below Fair Value On Its Earnings Story?
Author: Bailey Pemberton   Sun, September 27, 2026 at 3:09 AM GMT+2 3 min read
Published: 2026-09-27T01:09:17+00:00
=== BODY ===
Reddit shares have dropped sharply year to date, and with the stock back under pressure, the live question is whether today's valuation can be squared with the earnings power the business is putting on the table.
The stock is down 38.1% year to date, which puts the focus firmly on whether the current share price still lines up with what Reddit earns.
Recent revenue growth and user trends suggest the platform may support higher profitability over time, which feeds directly into how investors frame its earnings base.
There is a second opinion on Reddit worth weighing. See what analysts think Reddit's shares could be worth.
The stock's next move may depend on whether Reddit's current price is justified by its earnings today and the profit stream investors expect to see from here.
If you are weighing Reddit against other opportunities tied to earnings power, it can help to compare it with 32 high quality undervalued stocks.
A P/E lens fits Reddit because the market is clearly keying off earnings power and the recent profit narrative. On this metric, the stock trades at about 33.1x earnings, which is above both the Interactive Media and Services sector average of roughly 10.1x and a peer group mark near 28.8x. That is a meaningfully richer tag than the broad industry and also a premium to closer comparables.
The Fair Ratio model, which adjusts for Reddit's growth profile, margins, size and risk, points to a lower P/E than where the shares change hands today, so the current multiple screens as overvalued on this framework. Because the latest Q2 report showed strong revenue and user metrics, the high P/E appears to reflect confidence that these fundamentals can sustain Reddit's earnings story.
